ground_truth.title: Milwaukee Coworking Space: Ward4
ground_truth.main_content:
Where driven professionals

work together in an innovative

community.

Ward4 provides amazing office and coworking spaces to entrepreneurs, start-ups, venture capital-backed companies, small to mid-sized businesses, global corporations and innovative technologists. An alternative to traditional commercial office space, Ward4 provides companies a powerful operating platform combining the best tech connectivity with corporate spaces that are industrial, collaborative and full of community.

Workspace

Specialized, flexible office spaces designed to fit your business. Private suites, private offices, individual memberships and conference rooms are offered. Scale up or down as your business needs change.

Learn More →

Events

Our unique and innovative spaces make Ward4 the ideal location for events ranging from private meetings, staff meetings and corporate events to simply networking over cocktails.

Book An Event→

Community

The physical space and our members themselves both create a driven and innovative community bursting with entrepreneurial spirit. A lighthouse for innovation, and a destination in Milwaukee's growing tech scene.

Our Members→

Member Benefits

Our members enjoy 24/7 access to the space along with all amenities necessary to become a part of Milwaukee's thriving entrepreneurial ecosystem.
